commentary_title: Subdued trade in the Mediterranean to weaken tonnage demand
commentary_summary: The global vessel speed dipped in week 4 as subdued oil demand in the market weighed on the vessel demand. However, owing to more vessels rerouting to avoid the Red Sea, the tonne miles index increased to 103.3 points. | With many refineries going into maintenance, freight rates also fell on most major routes. The Aframax market in the North Sea region was steady in week 4 despite the Red Sea causing some disruptions in tonnage replenishments. | Next week could see a declining tonnage headed towards the East with more vessels ballasting from Singapore. | MoM percentage point change in utilisation**
